goal: Reject multipath Miniscript descriptors containing duplicate keys on any branch during parsing
Prevents importing descriptors that lead to wallet reload failures or invalid spending policies
reviewability: Reviewing the logic now is worthwhile as the rebase onto master is mechanical
agreement: Strong support with no open objections
Verified that duplicate keys on subsequent branches are caught instead of silently passing (Zeegaths)
Concept approval from experience hitting the same multipath issue (l0rinc)
Concept approval noting alignment with BIP 389 after reproducing the bug (vicjuma)
Open suggestions to simplify checking and add functional tests for wallet reloads (l0rinc)

categories.name: wallet
why: P2 because it prevents importing invalid descriptors that can break wallet reloading
Ensures duplicate keys on secondary multipath branches are caught before wallets accept them
